domain: Agile Project Management and Task Tracking
scenario:
A software development company is implementing an enterprise-level Agile Project Management Platform designed to streamline task management, resource allocation, and project tracking for various software development projects. The platform will manage user stories, track their progress, estimate required resources, and prioritize tasks to ensure efficient project execution.

The system must enable the creation and management of user stories, assign priorities based on business needs, and provide accurate time estimations for each task. It should facilitate real-time tracking of task completion and offer insights into project timelines and productivity metrics. The platform should also support the integration of team collaboration tools to improve communication and coordination among team members.

Additionally, the platform will include advanced reporting features to analyze project progress, identify bottlenecks, and optimize resource allocation. User roles and permissions will be established to control access to sensitive project data, ensuring that only authorized personnel can modify critical project elements. This robust system will support project managers, developers, and stakeholders in managing complex software development projects effectively.
